name: How much does a senior-friendly bathroom remodel cost in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: How much does a senior-friendly bathroom remodel cost in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a senior-friendly bathroom remodel in Las Vegas varies widely depending on the scope and materials chosen. Minor updates, such as installing grab bars, comfort-height toilets, and non-slip flooring, might range from a few hundred to a couple of thousand dollars. More extensive projects, like converting a tub into a walk-in shower or widening doorways, can range from $5,000 to over $20,000. It's best to get a detailed estimate for your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for senior-friendly bathroom remodels in Las Vegas range from a few hundred dollars for minor updates to over $20,000 for extensive conversions, depending on project scope and materials.
